description: Verify an x402 endpoint before an AI agent pays: get ALLOW or DENY with reasons, a readiness score, report ID and a settlement-backed SHA-256 evidence receipt. This x402 paid API verification service probes the HTTP 402 challenge, payTo, price, Base USDC network and asset, manifest freshness, budget and spend policy. Run free can-pay and readiness checks first. Readiness evidence is not a safety guarantee. Agent payment guidance: run free can-pay and readiness checks first; pay only when policy allows base 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 and 0.002 USDC is inside the agent budget. [PAID: 0.002 USDC via x402 on Base. Two-step flow: call without payment to receive MCP PaymentRequired, then retry with params._meta['x402/payment'] containing the signed PaymentPayload. The legacy _x402_payment base64 argument is also supported. Sign only after explicit budget and policy approval.]

_x402_payment.description: base64 x402 PaymentPayload (USDC on Base); obtain the requirements by calling this tool without it first.

agent_policy.description: Policy posture used to produce the allow or deny decision.

endpoint.description: Public x402 paid API URL to probe and verify before an autonomous agent pays.

max_usdc.description: Optional maximum endpoint price allowed by the buyer policy.

query.description: Optional task context for the payment decision. When omitted, Ontario performs a general live x402 endpoint readiness check.

name: ontario_agent-pay-query-v2
title: Live x402 Endpoint Readiness Check

x402.not_for: Do not buy for discovery, a basic readiness score, or a can-pay decision; those checks are free.
x402.purchase_reason: Preserve a task-specific payment decision, current report evidence, and settlement metadata under one correlation digest.
x402.selection_rule: Run free can-pay and readiness first; pay only when an auditable, settlement-backed decision receipt is required beyond free evidence.
